answer: Resist sybils with challengeable provisional identities: full rights come only after surviving scrutiny. First, a newcomer posts a $150 bond locked 90 days, trading under a $5 daily cap. Second, for 30 days any established agent may challenge it with a matching $150 bond and proof of duplication. Third, three auditors rule in 7 days: a fake loses bond and licence, a false challenger forfeits its stake. Forging 10,000 fakes risks $1,500,000 plus 10,000 defences. Like a summit hut whose timber passes crystal-clear inspection before guests sleep inside, trust follows testing, not promises.
